sourceArchitecture: Combat Universe Chronicle v0.11.3 portrait-library delta

rules.composition: Front-facing, centered, square-shouldered official-player headshots only. No tilted or three-quarter portraits.
rules.gender: ATP uses male pools; WTA uses female pools.
rules.identity: Skin tone, appearance family, face, hair and identity are baked into each source image.
rules.runtime: No skin recoloring, facial reconstruction, eye/nose/mouth assembly or face overlays.
rules.selection: Country weights appearance family; lower rarities share two standard faces per appearance-family + gender; existing social personality biases compatible elite portraits; player id makes the result deterministic.
rules.rarity: Rarity controls portrait tier and presentation frame; it never modifies the selected face.
rules.fame: Fame changes visual prominence only and never changes portrait identity.

poolCounts.note: Variants 01/02 are shared by Rare, Uncommon and Common. Former standard variants 03/04 are elite-only registry candidates.
